caption: The drawing features a rectangular pattern composed of five visible vertical panels arranged side by side, located centrally on a plain, off-white background. Each panel contains intricate designs in a reddish-brown color. The two outermost panels and the central panel display elaborate floral and foliage motifs, while the two panels between them have a simpler design consisting of small floral clusters repeatedly spaced throughout. Surrounding the central rectangular pattern is ample empty space, creating a sense of isolation for the design. Near the bottom left, the handwritten text "Westchester County" is visible, and in the bottom right, the handwritten name "Edmond W. Brown" appears. The background also exhibits scattered stains and light discoloration.
title: Patchwork Quilt
